metadata.title: A semi-discrete scheme for horizontal mean curvature flow in the Heisenberg group
metadata.abstract: The horizontal mean curvature flow is a geometric evolution associated with the horizontal perimeter in sub-Riemannian spaces. In this paper, we introduce a minimizing movement scheme for this flow in the first Heisenberg group $\mathbb{H}$, and prove the existence of a flat flow which is locally $1/2$-Hölder continuous in time, with respect to the $L^1$-distance. The construction applies to arbitrary bounded sets of finite horizontal perimeter and does not require smoothness or symmetry of the initial datum.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在第一 Heisenberg 群中为水平平均曲率流建立 minimizing movement 离散时间方案，并证明任意有界有限水平周长初值均可构造 flat flow，在 L1 距离下具有局部时间 1/2-Hölder 连续性。
analysis.breakthrough: 无需初值光滑或对称，为退化几何流给出较一般的变分存在理论。
